about: Lab protocols shown on the cell culture log web page. Claude Code writes this file from the protocol files in this folder.

protocols.title: Complete culture medium
steps: Add FBS to a final concentration of 10%.
Add hygromycin B to 0.01 mg/mL (to maintain stable clones).
protocols.source_note: From the 4D Nucleosome consortium (adapted from ATCC).

protocols.title: Thawing cells
steps: Frozen vials are stored in the vapour phase of the LN2 dewar.
Prepare a T75 flask with 12 mL complete medium. Put it in the incubator for at least 15 min so the medium reaches pH 7.0–7.6.
Thaw the vial in a 37°C water bath with gentle swirling, keeping the O-ring and cap out of the water. Thawing should take about 2–2.5 min.
Take the vial out as soon as it is thawed. Spray it with 70% ethanol and bring it into the TC hood.
Transfer the vial contents to a centrifuge tube with 9.0 mL complete medium. Centrifuge for 5 min (the centrifuge has no rpm or rcf setting).
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 1 mL fresh medium. Add this to the T75 flask.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2.
protocols.source_note: From the 4D Nucleosome consortium (adapted from ATCC).

protocols.title: Passaging cells
steps: Volumes are for a T75 flask; scale the dissociation volumes for other vessels.
Remove and discard the culture medium.
Briefly rinse the cell layer with 5 mL 0.05% (w/v) Trypsin – 0.53 mM EDTA to remove serum (it contains trypsin inhibitor).
Add 4 mL Trypsin-EDTA and incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
Tap the flask to reduce clumping if needed.
Add 6 mL complete medium and collect the cells by gently pipetting.
Resuspend in an appropriate volume of complete medium and count the cells.
Seed 4,000–6,000 viable cells/cm². For a T75 we seed 300,000–400,000 cells.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2.

seeding.note: An inoculum of 4 x 10^3 to 6 x 10^3 viable cells/cm2 is recommended. For T75 flasks, we inoculate between 300,000 to 400,000 cells.

protocols.source_note: From the 4D Nucleosome consortium (adapted from ATCC).

protocols.title: Change media
steps: Change the medium every 2 days (or as needed).
Use 12 mL for a T75 and 5 mL for a T25.
protocols.source_note: From the 4D Nucleosome consortium (adapted from ATCC).

protocols.title: LIF stock and JM8.N4 medium
steps: LIF stock: spin the lyophilized LIF vial briefly. Add sterile 0.1% BSA in water to 0.1 mg/mL (10^7 U/mL).
Dilute 1:10 in medium to make a 10^6 U/mL working stock. Aliquot into single-use tubes (e.g. 600 µL). Store at −20°C; use within 3 months.

Medium (~600 mL): to 500 mL KnockOut DMEM add 90 mL FBS (not heat-inactivated, 15%), 6 mL GlutaMAX (2 mM), 6 mL MEM NEAA (1X), 6 mL Pen/Strep (1X), 600 µL LIF (1000 U/mL) and 4.6 µL 2-mercaptoethanol (0.1 mM; a 1:10 dilution stock is easier to pipette).
Filter the whole bottle through a 0.2 µm filter unit.
Label "JM8.N4 medium", date and initials. Store at 4°C in the dark; use within ~2 weeks. Aliquots keep at −20°C for up to 3 months.
Each day, warm only the volume you need.
0.25% trypsin (1X): aliquot and freeze at −20°C.

defaults.media: JM8.N4 medium: KnockOut DMEM + 15% FBS + 2 mM GlutaMAX + 1X NEAA + 1X Pen/Strep + 1000 U/mL LIF + 0.1 mM 2-ME

protocols.source_note: LIF/serum, feeder-free; adapted from the 4DN SOP (revised July 2017).

protocols.title: Gelatin coating
steps: Cells do not attach well without gelatin. Coat at least 30 min before use.
Add 0.1% gelatin: 1.5 mL per well of a 6-well plate, about 5 mL for a 10 cm dish, 3 mL for a T25.
Put in the 37°C incubator for ~30 min to 3 h.
Just before adding cells, aspirate the gelatin and add pre-warmed medium.
Coated plates (gelatin left on) can be kept at 37°C and used within 7 days.
protocols.source_note: LIF/serum, feeder-free; adapted from the 4DN SOP (revised July 2017).

protocols.title: Cells from a frozen vial (Day 0)
steps: Freezing medium contains DMSO, which harms warm cells. Get the cells out of it within 5 min.
Ready first: a gelatin-coated 6-well plate in the incubator, medium warmed to 37°C, a 15 mL tube with 9 mL warm medium in the hood, centrifuge set to 1,000 rpm, 5 min.
Take the vial from liquid nitrogen. Swirl gently in the 37°C water bath for ~1–2 min until only a tiny ice crystal is left.
Spray the vial with 70% ethanol, wipe it, and put it in the hood.
With a 1 mL pipette, add the cells drop by drop into the 9 mL warm medium. Rinse the vial with 1 mL medium from the tube.
Centrifuge at 1,000 rpm for 5 min.
Aspirate the liquid carefully without touching the small white pellet.
Add 2 mL warm medium and pipette up and down 3–5 times.
Aspirate the gelatin from one well and add the 2 mL of cells. Rock the plate forward-back and left-right to spread the cells; do not swirl.
Label the plate: cell line, date, initials and passage number.
Put the plate in the 37°C, 5% CO2 humidified incubator.
Next day: check for small attached colonies (some floating dead cells are normal). Replace all the medium with 2 mL fresh warm medium.
Days 2–3: change the medium every day. Split when the well is 70–80% covered with colonies.

defaults.media: JM8.N4 medium: KnockOut DMEM + 15% FBS + 2 mM GlutaMAX + 1X NEAA + 1X Pen/Strep + 1000 U/mL LIF + 0.1 mM 2-ME

protocols.source_note: LIF/serum, feeder-free; adapted from the 4DN SOP (revised July 2017).

protocols.title: Daily care
steps: Check the cells under the microscope every day. Healthy colonies are round, tightly packed and shiny, with smooth, bright edges.
Change the medium every day (2 mL per well of a 6-well plate). Aspirate from the side of the well, then add fresh warm medium gently down the side.
Split at 70–80% confluence. Do not let colonies touch and merge; overgrown ES cells start to differentiate.

defaults.media: JM8.N4 medium: KnockOut DMEM + 15% FBS + 2 mM GlutaMAX + 1X NEAA + 1X Pen/Strep + 1000 U/mL LIF + 0.1 mM 2-ME

protocols.source_note: LIF/serum, feeder-free; adapted from the 4DN SOP (revised July 2017).

protocols.title: Splitting cells (one well of a 6-well plate)
steps: Ready first: new gelatin-coated wells, warm medium, warm DPBS, 0.25% trypsin (room temperature or 37°C).
Aspirate the medium from the well.
Wash once with 2 mL DPBS. Aspirate.
Add 0.5 mL 0.25% trypsin to cover the cells.
Incubate at 37°C for 1–2 min. Check that the cells are rounded and lifting; tap gently if needed. Do not leave trypsin longer than needed.
Add at least 1 mL medium (2× the trypsin volume) to stop the trypsin.
Pipette up and down 7–10 times, gently, to break the colonies. Avoid bubbles.
Transfer to a 15 mL tube and centrifuge at 1,000 rpm for 5 min.
Aspirate the liquid and resuspend the pellet in fresh medium.
Plate into new gelatin-coated wells (gelatin aspirated first): 3.5 x 10^5 cells per well of a 6-well plate in 2 mL, or split 1:6 by ratio.
Rock the plate to spread the cells. Label with the new passage number (+1), date and initials. Return to the incubator.
Scale-up by vessel (gelatin / medium / trypsin): 6-well well 1.5 / 2 / 0.5 mL; T25 3 / 5 / 1 mL; 10 cm dish 5 / 10 / 2 mL.

seeding.note: 3.5 x 10^5 cells per well of a 6-well plate (9.5 cm2), which is about 36,842 cells/cm2. Or split 1:6 by ratio.

defaults.media: JM8.N4 medium: KnockOut DMEM + 15% FBS + 2 mM GlutaMAX + 1X NEAA + 1X Pen/Strep + 1000 U/mL LIF + 0.1 mM 2-ME

protocols.source_note: LIF/serum, feeder-free; adapted from the 4DN SOP (revised July 2017).

protocols.title: Freezing new vials
steps: Freeze only healthy, fast-growing cells at 70–80% confluence. Aim for about 2 million cells per vial (one confluent 6-well well per vial).

Ready first: cryovials labelled "JM8.N4", passage number, date, cells per vial and initials; Mr. Frosty at room temperature with fresh isopropanol (change every 5 uses); HyCryo-Stem 2X kept cold; warm medium, DPBS and trypsin.
Detach the cells as for splitting (DPBS wash → trypsin 1–2 min → stop with medium → pipette to single cells → 15 mL tube). Pool all wells to freeze.
Count the cells and work out how many vials you can make.
Centrifuge at 1,000 rpm for 5 min.
Aspirate. Resuspend the pellet in 0.5 mL cold medium per vial (e.g. 5 vials → 2.5 mL).
Add an equal volume of HyCryo-Stem 2X and mix gently (this makes 1X freezing medium).
Quickly add 1 mL to each cryovial and put the vials straight into the Mr. Frosty.
Put the container at −80°C overnight (~24 h).
Next day, move the vials to liquid nitrogen. Do not leave them at −80°C for more than 72 h.

defaults.freezeMedia: HyCryo-Stem 2X mixed 1:1 with cold JM8.N4 medium (1X)

protocols.source_note: LIF/serum, feeder-free; adapted from the 4DN SOP (revised July 2017).
